title: Applied Statistical Methods II
weeklyTopics: Fitting a linear model to a sample by least squares
Toward a population version of the linear model (random variables)
Colinearity and design matrices for interactions/factors
skills: design matrices for interactions and factors
workloadNotes: 9 weekly homework assignments, 13 labs, 2 lab quizzes, a midterm exam, and a comprehensive final exam. Homework graded on completeness (with required 'Sources' and 'Please explain' statements), not correctness.
prerequisitesText: MATH 115 and one of (STATS 180, STATS 250, STATS 280, STATS 412, or ECON 451); no credit if STATS 413 completed/enrolled.
textbooks: A Modern Approach to Regression with R (S. Sheather)
